headline: Employment, new jump in jobs: 307,000 more positions in a year. Over 1.1 million since the Meloni government took office
summary: Italian labour data show 307,000 more employed people over the past year. The report says more than 1.1 million jobs have been added since the Meloni government took office.
why: Employment and unemployment data shape consumer spending and the outlook for Italian growth and government bond demand.
